accessories.name: Wulfrum Controller
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: Summons a wulfrum droid to fight for you · Hold ⚷ Open / Activate while holding the remote to switch all of your drones between regular and supercharge mode · Supercharged droids will stop attacking and focus wulfrum energy onto you · Supercharged droids provide +0.25 HP/s life regen and 2 defense per droid · Can also be used to heal other players by keeping your mouse cursor close enough to them

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Black Glass Band
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

accessories.name: Angel Treads
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

accessories.name: Fairy Boots
accessories.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

accessories.name: Asgard's Valor
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear

accessories.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks

accessories.name: Shield of the High Ruler
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

accessories.name: Interstellar Stompers
accessories.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris
accessories.source: Dropped by the Leviathan and Anahita
accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

accessories.name: Apollyon

items.name: Master Ninja Gear

items.effect: Allows the ability to climb walls and dash · Gives a chance to dodge attacks

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.why: This no longer grants infinite flight.
items.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

items.name: Blood Pact
items.why: This should be used with Bloom Stone

items.name: Frozen Shield

items.name: Living Dew

items.name: Star Veil

items.name: Celestial Starboard
items.why: This has powerful hover and boost abilities.
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Press Down to toggle hover · Press Up to deactivate hover · Hold Up to boost faster! · 'The more you know'

items.name: Exodus Wings
items.why: This should be used with Empyrean armor
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Great · Vertical acceleration: Great · Grants permanent Empyrean Wrath while wearing the Empyrean armor · Pulsing with an alien heartbeat

items.name: Empyrean armor
items.why: This should be used with Empyrean armor

items.name: Moon Walkers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 2.67 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Great · Max vertical speed: Great · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Good · 24% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Hee hee!'

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.why: This no longer grants infinite flight.
items.effect: Grants infinite wing and rocket boot flight · Increases flight and jump mobility

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Puts a shell around the owner when below 50% life that reduces damage by 25% · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when above 25% life

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

items.name: Blunder Booster
items.effect: 12% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue projectile velocity · Stealth generates 10% faster · Summons a red lightning aura around the player that electrifies nearby enemies with Vermillion Flux · The aura has reduced opacity if visibility is disabled · Press Booster Dash to consume 25% of your maximum stealth to perform a swift upwards diagonal dash · This dash leaves a trail of red lightning bolts · This effect has a 1 second cooldown before it can be used again

items.name: Dark Matter Sheath
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · Stealth generation is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

items.name: Destroyer Emblem
items.effect: 10% increased damage · 8% increased critical strike chance

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: Increases armor penetration by 10 · 10% increased damage

items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.
items.effect: Multiplies all damage based on how close you are to enemies · Maximum damage boost is 15%, minimum damage boost is -15% · Emit a blazing aura that burns and repels nearby enemies with Holy Flames · Enemies take increasing damage the closer they are to you and the longer they are near you · Effects are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

items.name: Abyssal Mirror
items.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Vampiric Talisman
items.effect: Rogue critical strikes steal enemy life · Stealth strikes grant 15% critical strike chance and increased lifesteal to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds · Stealth strikes inflict Heavy Bleeding and Armor Crunch , and deal 8% more damage · 'Possessing the talisman makes you yearn for blood'

weapons.name: Empyrean Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a flurry of homing knives that bounce off of tiles and heal the user

weapons.name: Holy Collider
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Swings a holy greatsword that can be charged for higher damage · Charged swings create four lingering flares that float around the point of impact · Striking a flare with an uncharged swing will push it around and extend its lifetime · Charged swings can empower flares, turning them into massive fireballs on hit and launching them to your cursor

weapons.name: Meowmere
weapons.source: Dropped by Moon Lord
weapons.why: Fires bouncing wall-piercing cat-head projectiles on swing.

weapons.name: Pulse Dragon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws two mechanical dragon heads that emit damaging electrical fields · 'Yharim specifically requested this weapon to be modelled after the Dragons of old. · How trite.'

weapons.name: Stellar Contempt
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits call down more and more lunar flares from the sky · After hitting five times, the hammer supercharges with lunar energy to pulverize your target

weapons.name: Terratomere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Heals the player on true melee hits · Fires several piercing energy bolts that rapidly seek targets · On hit, explodes and repeatedly slashes the target · 'Linked to the essence of Terraria'

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Relic of Deliverance
weapons.source: Dropped by the Guardian Commander
weapons.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

accessories.name: Profaned Soul Artifact
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Summons your own personal Guardians to fight alongside you · The offensive guardian grants an additional minion slot and fires a ring of spears while attacking · The defensive guardian creates a weak barrier of profaned rock · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · Once depleted, the rocks are flung outward and will regenerate 5 seconds after being hit · Taking damage resets the timer · The healer guardian restores 10 health every few seconds · Purity

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Star-Tainted Generator
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

accessories.name: Statis' Curse

weapons.effect: Fires a rapid stream of short-range kunai · Stealth strikes make kunai pierce foes, travel farther, and spawn 9 homing scythes

weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Throws a spinning scythe that lingers at your cursor · ⚷ Open / Activate to recall all existing scythes · Recalling a scythe while it's on an enemy rends them for massive damage · ⚷ Open / Activate with sufficient stealth to empower the next 30 scythes and greatly increase attack speed · You cannot recall scythes thrown while empowered

weapons.name: Tarragon Throwing Dart
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a piercing dart · Stealth strikes erupt into thorns on enemy hits

weapons.name: Twisting Thunder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a lightning bolt to electrocute enemies · The lightning bolt travels faster while it is raining · Summons lightning from the sky on impact · Stealth strikes summon more lightning and travel faster

weapons.name: Wave Pounder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a bomb which explodes into a agonizingly forceful shockwave · Stealth strikes emit absurdly powerful shockwaves

weapons.name: Profaned Partisan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a profaned spear that splits into miniature spears upon hitting an enemy · Stealth strikes remain impaled in an enemy for 10 seconds · While an enemy is impaled, all spears that strike them instead shatter into exploding stars

weapons.name: Reality Rupture
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Cycles between throwing 3 small homing spears and throwing a single piercing lance · Stealth Strikes throw a high-velocity reality shattering lance that explodes on hit

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Relic of Deliverance
weapons.source: Dropped by the Guardian Commander
weapons.effect: Using ⚒ Use / Attack mounts you on the spear; holding ⚒ Use / Attack revvs the spear, slowing you down · Release to launch yourself at high speeds, halved while a boss is alive · Losing too much speed while charging will bust the charge, resetting your speed · The dash allows you to ram through enemies and travel through tiles · Being inside tiles for too long will warp you back to where you entered · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to dismount · Holding out the spear heavily reduces the damage of all summons · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · Vengeance fueled me, I had no thought other than exactment. · The dragon took everything from me, leaving my broken pieces strewn on the ground. · But when I danced by Her side, I knew there was something still worth fighting for.

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

weapons.name: Crescent Moon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a lunar flail that releases homing moons at the apex of its path · Holding ⚒ Use / Attack spins the flail around you, generating Starbursts · With 20 Starbursts, hold ⚒ Use / Attack again after throwing the flail to cause it to explode · Instead of releasing moons, this explosion summons Scorpius to do immense damage and inflict Voidfrost · 'Lunacy derived from genius'

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'

weapons.name: Death's Ascension
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Performs powerful soul-infused swings that creates a rift orbited by scythes on enemy hits · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to launch a barrage of homing scythes · The rift will fire scythes along with you · 'It feels just right in your grip... · But the hands that wield it are not yours'

weapons.name: Galileo Gladius
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Rapidly stabs in front of the player, generating Starbursts on hit · ⚷ Open / Activate to throw the gladius on a constellation chain, impaling foes and inflicting Voidfrost · When the blade is impaled, use ⚒ Use / Attack or ⚷ Open / Activate to free it · ⚒ Use / Attack pulls it free and deals high damage, consuming 10 Starbursts · ⚷ Open / Activate pulls yourself to the blade, allowing you to jump off the foe · Jumping off a foe consumes 20 Starbursts and provides invincibility · 'Figaro, magnifico'

weapons.name: Neptune's Bounty
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Tosses a spinning abyssal sword which constantly sprays water energy · Once the blade begins falling, it will redirect itself towards enemies with increased velocity and 2x damage

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

accessories.name: The Community
accessories.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

accessories.name: Elysian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to dash, empowered by holy fire · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage · 'Blessed by the Profaned Flame'

accessories.name: Statis' Ninja Belt
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 10% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.6x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Leviathan Ambergris

accessories.effect: 100% increased initial dash velocity, 33% faster dash cooldown, and greatly increased dash deceleration · Your dashes are empowered by water, knocking back and damaging enemies with vicious currents · Visual effects are reduced if visibility is disabled

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

accessories.name: Badge of Bravery
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10% · Increases melee armor penetration by 5

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

accessories.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

accessories.name: Deific Amulet

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.name: Quiver of Nihility
items.why: This is difficult to use and should be used with Monsoon

items.name: Monsoon
items.why: This is difficult to use and should be used with Monsoon
items.effect: Fires a spread of 5 arrows · Wooden arrows are converted into typhoon arrows and sharks

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

items.name: Recon Scope
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance · Enemies are less likely to target you · 'Enemy spotted'

items.name: Sniper Scope

items.name: Profaned Soul Artifact

weapons.name: Deep Sea Dumbbell
weapons.source: Dropped by Reaper Sharks after Polterghast has been defeated
weapons.effect: Throws a dumbbell that bounces and flings weights with each bounce · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to flex, increasing the damage of your next attack up to 5 times damage · Flexes can hit enemies directly

weapons.name: Jaws of Oblivion
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a tight spread of six reaper teeth with Acid Venom that stick in enemies · The Acid Venom can stack when more teeth are stuck in an enemy · Stealth strikes cause the teeth to emit a crushing shockwave on impact · 'You're gonna need a bigger boat'

weapons.name: Sealed Singularity
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Disables normal stealth generation · Throws a contained singularity bomb that slows down and creates a damaging field after a short fuse · Hold ⚒ Use / Attack to generate stealth, but burn through the bomb's fuse · After the field collapses, the singularity seeks out the strongest target that it hit and explodes · Stealth strikes increase the size and duration of the damaging field · Will explode in your hand if you hold the fuse too long

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a scythe that cuts through enemies · Deposits unstable isotopes on hit, which create delayed nuclear explosions when they decay · Stealth strikes are thrown into the sky and fall upon enemies and few seconds later · On hit, stealth strikes create a focused deluge of acid rain

weapons.name: Toxicant Twister
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Throws a fan of four spinning disks that swirl around your cursor · Stealth strikes swirl in a wider range and create a vortex of raindrops that home in on enemies

weapons.name: Vega
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a spear that shatters into star fragments on impact and generates Starbursts · Stealth strike conjure an image of Lyra to deal immense damage in an area · ⚷ Open / Activate to consume 20 Starbursts and immediately perform a stealth strike, regardless of your current stealth · This strike calls all star fragments to attack the damaged foe and inflicts Voidfrost · Consuming Starbursts with Vega allows using stealth for 10 seconds, even without rogue armor · 'The final song of a misunderstood genius... or just a madman'

weapons.name: Molten Amputator
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Throws a spinning scythe that lingers at your cursor · ⚷ Open / Activate to recall all existing scythes · Recalling a scythe while it's on an enemy rends them for massive damage · ⚷ Open / Activate with sufficient stealth to empower the next 30 scythes and greatly increase attack speed · You cannot recall scythes thrown while empowered

weapons.name: Twisting Thunder
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a lightning bolt to electrocute enemies · The lightning bolt travels faster while it is raining · Summons lightning from the sky on impact · Stealth strikes summon more lightning and travel faster

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

weapons.name: Stratus Sphere
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Launches a singularity which exerts influence on all entities in a large area around it · Influenced players gain Starbursts over time and will consume Starbursts to fly when out of flight time · ⚷ Open / Activate to cause Starbursts to form a barrier, causing you to lose Starbursts instead of health · Launching the singularity deactivates the barrier, and creating the barrier deactivates the singularity · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats · 'Channeling souls into stars, an inane concept'

weapons.name: Devil's Devastation

weapons.name: Galaxy Smasher
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Consecutive hits summon more and more cosmic shards · After hitting eight times, the hammer supercharges itself with galactic energies, · delivering an apocalyptic strike that reverberates through space and time

weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast
weapons.effect: Summons a phantom to protect you

weapons.name: Mirror of Kalandra
weapons.source: Crafted at a Shimmer
weapons.effect: Summons five ancient weapons to annihilate your enemies · There can only be one of each individual weapon · Atziri's Disfavor brutally cleaves through enemies · Starforge rips through foes and occasionally induces cosmic explosions · Paradoxica teleports to enemies and blitzes through them at high speed · Wind Ripper unleashes a single high-speed, powerful arrow at enemies · Hope Shredder shoots arrows that split into three and pierce enemies twice · 'Ultimate, Immeasurable, Indescribable'

weapons.name: Sirius
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons the brightest star in the sky, Sirius, to protect you · Continue summoning to complete Canis Major · Repeated summons increase its power greatly, even after the constellation is complete · Sirius passively generates Starbursts when targeting enemies · When Starbursts are full, Sirius consumes them to launch a powerful piercing quasar that inflicts Voidfrost · 'A guide to a dream never realized'

weapons.name: Void Eater Marionette
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: Contains the power to control a mini Devourer · Repeated summons increase the length and power of the Devourer · The Devourer attacks with Divinity Devourer, Faith Incinerator, and Ultracosmic Maelstrom · Can play fetch with dropped items · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory when the Devourer has been spawned to prioritize fetching

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a gross, shark-puking Old Duke head on the ground

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

weapons.name: Claret Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a hypercondensed claret round · The round explodes upon striking an enemy and releases blood orbs · The explosion shreds enemies, dramatically reducing their defense · Picking up the blood orbs will reduce Potion Sickness when possible · If you do not have Potion Sickness , your natural regeneration will be enhanced · Can only fire once every 10 seconds · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

accessories.name: Profaned Soul Artifact

accessories.name: The Absorber

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Nucleogenesis
accessories.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 4 · Grants immunity to Shadowflame and Irradiated · 15% increased summon damage, and increased minion knockback · Minions inflict a variety of debuffs · Minions spawn damaging sparks on enemy hits · Does not stack with downgrades

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

accessories.name: Ambrosial Ampoule

items.name: Silva Wings
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.5 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'The purest of nature'

items.name: Void Striders
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 3.33 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 36% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Ludicrous speed!'

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.why: This should be used with Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.why: This should be used with Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'

weapons.name: Ark of the Cosmos
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: ⚒ Use / Attack to perform a 5-swing combo that ends by throwing the blade · The thrown blade will follow your cursor · Releasing while the blade is out will cause an exploding snap · ⚷ Open / Activate to snip out the scissor blades in front of you · Hitting an enemy with it will parry them, granting you brief invulnerability · You can parry projectiles to make them deal 120 less damage for a short period · Parrying will empower the next 16 swings of the sword · Double ⚷ Open / Activate with charges available to cause a Big Rip in spacetime and consume all charges · The physical culmination of your journey, capable of rending gods asunder

weapons.name: Dragon Pow
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a dragon head that releases Dragonfire sparks · Summons a barrage of petals and waterfalls on enemy hits

weapons.name: Orderbringer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires piercing energy waves and summons four homing stars near your cursor · Hits with the blade summon two beams from the sky · 'No matter where you may be you are never alone'

weapons.name: The Burning Sky
weapons.source: Dropped by Yharon
weapons.effect: Rains down a stream of Dragonfire at the cursor · 'Hold the blade to the sky, and witness Armageddon'

weapons.name: Zenith
weapons.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

accessories.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

accessories.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
accessories.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

accessories.name: Radiance
accessories.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

accessories.name: Rampart of Deities
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer

items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: Void Vortex
items.why: This should be used with Void Vortex
items.effect: Conjures a swirling vortex of supercharged magnet spheres around the cursor that explodes into a storm of homing mini spheres

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

items.name: Ethereal Talisman
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 and 8% reduced mana cost · 15% increased magic damage and 5% increased magic critical strike chance · Increases pickup range for mana stars · You automatically use mana potions when needed · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate in your inventory to toggle Mana Flower's effect

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

items.name: Sigil of Calamitas
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 60 · 15% increased magic damage · Increases pickup range for mana stars

weapons.name: Lilies of Finality
weapons.source: Found in the Brimstone Crag after Yharon
weapons.effect: Can only be summoned once · 'Wake up'

weapons.name: Midnight Sun Beacon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a UFO to vaporize enemies

weapons.name: Mirror of Kalandra
weapons.source: Crafted at a Shimmer
weapons.effect: Summons five ancient weapons to annihilate your enemies · There can only be one of each individual weapon · Atziri's Disfavor brutally cleaves through enemies · Starforge rips through foes and occasionally induces cosmic explosions · Paradoxica teleports to enemies and blitzes through them at high speed · Wind Ripper unleashes a single high-speed, powerful arrow at enemies · Hope Shredder shoots arrows that split into three and pierce enemies twice · 'Ultimate, Immeasurable, Indescribable'

weapons.name: Saros Possession
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: Summons a radiant aura harnessing the power of primordial light · Repeated summons increase the power of the aura · ⚒ Use / Attack with full summon slots to channel Totality Ray · Totality Ray decays while in use and recharges when not in use · 'A ballet of light and shadow, torn from the sky'

weapons.name: Cadaverous Carrion
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a gross, shark-puking Old Duke head on the ground

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: Summons a sentry · Summons a friendly immolator that will float towards you · Immolators rapidly fire homing flares of Holy Flames at nearby enemies, before continuing to float near you again · After firing, Immolators will fire one healing bolt at you for every 4 summon slots you have · 'They might be a bit clingy, but at least they're warm'

weapons.name: Kaleidoscope
weapons.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light (summoned after Plantera)
weapons.why: Empress of Light drop giving one of the largest summon tag damage bonuses.
weapons.effect: 20 summon tag damage · 10% summon tag critical strike chance · Your summons will focus struck enemies

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Rod of Discord
weapons.source: Dropped by Chaos Elementals
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor · Causes the chaos state ( ) · Teleports you to the position of the cursor ( )

weapons.name: Normality Relocator
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Press Normality Relocator to teleport to the position of the mouse · Fall speed is doubled for 0.5 seconds after teleporting · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Works while in the inventory · 'I'll be there in the blink of an eye'

items.name: Seraph Tracers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 6 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 'Resplendent to the very end'

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: Gives all teammates +0.5 HP/s life regen, +10% max life, 7% damage reduction, 9 defense and 10% increased damage

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: 'The heart of (most of) the Terraria community' · Thank you to all of our supporters who made this mod a reality!

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: Pressing Spectral Veil Teleport consumes 25% of your maximum stealth to teleport, rendering you invulnerable · If you dodge something while invulnerable, you instantly gain full stealth · Teleportation is disabled while Chaos State is active · Stealth generates 15% faster · 'The inside of the cloak is full of teeth...'

weapons.name: Draconic Destruction

weapons.effect: Fires a draconic sword beam that explodes into additional beams · Additional beams fly up and down to shred enemies

weapons.name: Illustrious Knives

weapons.effect: Throws a barrage of fast-moving homing knives that heal the user

weapons.name: Ozzathoth

weapons.effect: Reach: 55 tiles · Speed: 60 · Infinite throw duration · Fires cosmic orbs that blast nearby enemies with lasers · 'Destroy the universe in the blink of an eye'

weapons.name: Red Sun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Drops a barrage of solar flares from the sky · 'Over paradise'

weapons.effect: Throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to you after striking an enemy · Enemy hits release prismatic light flares which orbit around the struck foe · Instead of returning, the fourth hit transforms flares into hardlight hammers · These hammers converge and form a universe-collapsing explosion that always critically strikes

weapons.name: Eye of Magnus
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Fires seeking cosmic masses that restore health and mana on hit · Explodes into a nebula cloud that cause[ sic ] enemies to become Marked for Death · This weapon scales with the average of all your damage stats

weapons.name: Rod of Harmony
weapons.effect: Teleports you to the position of the cursor

accessories.name: Shattered Community
accessories.effect: 'Ruined by unknowable hatred, it still contains (most of) the power of The Community...' · Increases damage, max health, and movement speed by 10% · Increases defense by 10, and life regen by 1 HP/s · Increases critical strike chance and damage reduction by 5%, and flight time by 20% · You generate rage over time and rage does not fade out of combat · Gain rage after taking damage regardless of defensive stats · While Rage Mode is active, taking damage gives only half as much rage · Deal damage with Rage Mode to further empower your wrath · Current level: [LEVEL] (+[BOOST]% Rage Mode damage) · Progress to next level: [PROGRESS RATIO]% · Total Rage Mode damage: [CUMULATIVE DAMAGE DEALT]

accessories.name: The Absorber
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

accessories.name: The Amalgam
accessories.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

accessories.name: The Evolution
accessories.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

accessories.name: Ascendant Insignia
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

accessories.name: Asgardian Aegis
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

accessories.name: Statis' Void Sash
accessories.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

accessories.name: Arc Flash Ring
accessories.effect: Attacks have a 5% chance to call down a lightning bolt for 3x damage · The chance is reduced for each enemy an attack hits · The bolt's damage is based on non-crit damage, but can itself crit · Bolts are transparent and silent if visibility is disabled

accessories.name: Calamity
accessories.effect: Lights your cursor ablaze with the Witch's flames, engulfing it in a blazing aura · Enemies touching the blaze take immense damage and are inflicted with Vulnerability Hex · Focusing an enemy for 2.5 seconds curses them, ascending Vulnerability Hex to its True form · Foes afflicted with True Vulnerability Hex take 1.15x damage from all sources · This effect is increased to 2.5x for the blazing cursor itself · Equip in a vanity slot to change the cursor without dealing damage · These changes work in conjunction with the Rainbow Cursor

accessories.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
accessories.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
accessories.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

accessories.name: Planebreaker's Pouch
accessories.effect: 15% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Grants a 20% chance to not consume arrows · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

accessories.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
accessories.effect: 20% increased damage · Increases armor penetration by 30 · 'A grisly trophy from the ultimate predator'

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
accessories.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

accessories.name: Chalice of the Blood God
accessories.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

accessories.name: Draedon's Heart
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 15% reduced contact damage from enemies · Replaces Adrenaline with the Nanomachines meter · Unlike Adrenaline, you lose no Nanomachines when you take damage, but they stop accumulating for 1 second · With full Nanomachines, press Adrenaline Mode to heal 180 health over 2 seconds · While healing you take [DR]% less damage · 'Nanomachines, son'

accessories.name: Radiance
accessories.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

accessories.name: Rampart of Deities
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

accessories.name: The Sponge
accessories.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Gain a barrier with 120 health · The barrier grants 10% damage reduction while active · Halved Adrenaline loss if all damage is absorbed · The barrier will regenerate 8 seconds after being hit, taking 10 seconds to completely regenerate · Getting hit resets the timer

items.name: Draedon's Heart

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
